_comment: POSTURE C ON THE FIELD — triple + free slant iono + GF code-bias datum,
305-station (303 in-network) DOY-129, 10 epochs.  THE FIRST FIELD ARM of the
posture validated on the synthetic fixture (SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network
§13.3.2/§13.5; sim arm _simnet60_tri_slant).  Structural smoke ONLY:
10 epochs is deep inside ignition for every level/calibration channel, so
vf / iono level / exchange / consumer verdicts are all BARRED (1 h rule,
HANDOFF_slant_triple_next §2).  Legal reads: wiring, datum inventory,
rank gate, canonical lock, counters, per-band admission.
DELTAS vs the inherited field record (_agu305_gps -> _ft63_24h_conv), each
deliberate:
- estimate_iono_sh false + ionosphere_weighting.enable false: the slant
posture.  Both are hard-error interlocks against code_bias_gf_datum
(GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:2226-2248) — under any single-layer constraint
the GF bias IS the estimable DCB and pinning it deletes the product.
- code_bias_gf_datum true (Odijk rd 3b, satellite side) + rx_code_bias_datum
true (rd 2b, receiver side; estimate_ifb is forced by the W6 slice so it
is not inert; sigma stays the 10 m default).
- frequency_mode triple (explicit, not 'all') + ARRAY signal whitelist:
C1C/L1C + C2W/L2W + C5Q/L5Q with C5X/L5X as band-5 fallback.  NOTE the
inherited string form 'WCSLXPYMIQ' puts C1W AHEAD of C1C, so the canonical
band-1 code CHANGES to C1C in this arm (cbq305 precedent, PppModel.cpp:462
whitelist semantics).  The IF/GF pinned pair is then (C1C,C2W), matching
the sim arm and the cbq305 lineage.
- closed_loop stripped to the sim posture-C consumer contract: products +
clock only, consume_network_iono OFF (there is no SH product to consume
under slant, and Table 8 moves the GF lump into the iono — the undiff
consumer's own iono states absorb it), ar_mode 0 (float).  The consumer
is NOT the subject of this smoke.
- eq34 + carry_invariant KEPT as inherited (field standard).  Zero-target
pins are healthy on real receivers (§12.8: phase-code lump at metres,
not the sim's km-scale draws).  seed_round stays OFF — the §13.7 settled
trio ratchet (eq34+carry+every-epoch re-round) is a seed_round composition
and is NOT armed here.
EXPECTED STRUCTURAL SIGNATURES (read these, in order — invariant #4):
1. 'Network producer (CB-GF-DATUM): ... ARMED' at load (also what
simnet_grade.py --gf-datum auto-detects, if a graded arm ever follows).
2. 'Canonical signals locked for GPS' = C1C/C2W/C5Q family, nothing else.
3. Datum inventory: per-sat IF + per-sat GF + s2z rows; n_gf_only_pair
should be ~the dozen non-L5 GPS satellites (IIR/IIR-M) — their code
biases are fully datum-fixed with nothing estimable, EXPECTED not a bug.
4. Rank gate at DEFAULT tolerance: declared_dim = n_below (the sim slant
arm emitted 20/20 at default tol; whether the field does is THE question
this smoke asks).  If it withholds, read the estimability dump knob
before touching rank_gate_tol.
5. Emitted 10/10 (or the named withhold reason per epoch), adm_screen
census, carry-chain counters live at run-end.
6. B records: pinned pair ~datum-exact, C5Q carrying the content (sim
signature: C1C/C2W mm-scale, C5Q metre-scale residual, converging).
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY — the posture, frequency_mode and signal set all change
the state vector and the fingerprint.  Never resume this from any prior
snapshot; nothing may resume from THIS 10-ep snapshot either.
10 epochs at 30 s: max_duration_s 271 covers t = 0..270 inclusive.
